title: Renewable Energy Systems Engineer
description:
The Renewable Energy Systems Engineer will support WSP’s renewable energy systems engineering capability across utility‑scale solar, wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This role is responsible for delivery excellence across the full project lifecycle — from early development through commissioning and operations.


The position plays a key role in strengthening WSP’s renewable energy engineering platform by establishing consistent renewable energy standards, scalable delivery models, and high‑quality client outcomes. The engineer will be involved in projects with our Systems Engineering Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.


  
* Design and model solar PV systems, Wind and BESS for utility\-scale, commercial, and microgrid applications using PVsyst, PVcase, and AutoCAD.
* Perform layout optimization, shading analysis, energy yield simulations, and loss assessments.
* Use NREL’s SAM or other bankable software for financial modeling, performance forecasting, and system cost\-benefit analysis.
* Conduct site assessments, review topographical data, and analyze meteorological datasets (e.g., TMY, DNI, GHI).
* Develop and maintain bill of materials (BOM), schematics, and as\-built drawings.
* Coordinate with interconnection, civil, and structural teams to ensure complete system integration.
* Support permitting, interconnection applications, and technical documentation for proposals and contracts.
* Develop augmentation optimization models for BESS systems
* Develop vendor\-specific system RTE calculations and ensure desired BESS output
* Collaborate with project managers, EPC partners, and other stakeholders to ensure design quality and technical compliance.
* Stay current on codes and standards (e.g., NEC, UL, IEEE, IEC) relevant to solar system design.

  
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in solar PV \+ BESS system design, preferably across utility, commercial, and microgrid scales.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, PVcase, PVsyst, and NREL SAM.
* A good understanding of North America markets, such as familiarity with North American EPC’s, Vendors etc.
* Strong understanding of PV system components, design standards, and layout strategies.
* Strong understanding of BESS system components, design standards, and US fire safety codes
* Strong understanding of battery chemistries (LFP, NMC, NCA, Flow batteries etc)
* Ability to read and produce engineering drawings, one\-line diagrams, and site plans.
* Solid knowledge of PV technologies, racking systems, and BOS (balance of system) components.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:


* Experience working on PV \+ storage systems or hybrid renewable microgrids.
* Familiarity with civil/site constraints, interconnection guidelines, and permitting processes.
* Exposure to Helioscope, PlantPredict, or similar modeling tools is a plus.
* EIT, PE license, or NABCEP certification is desirable but not required.
* Technical writing and publication experience

Preferred Competency


* Strong technical judgment and decision‑making ability
* Client‑focused and collaborative style
* Ability to balance technical rigor with project delivery needs
* Clear communicator across technical and non‑technical audiences
* Commitment to safety, quality, and professional excellence.

title: Applications/Systems Engineer - Post-Sales
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job Description
  
Role Customer Success Specialist – Pathology\& Sequencing Lab
  
Function Pathology Lab
  
Reporting Regional Manager – Pathology Lab
  
Organization Roche Diagnostics India\& Neighboring Markets
  
Location Bangalore
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

TheCustomer Success Specialist – Pathology \& Sequencing Lab is a field\-based position \- responsible for providing pre\-sales support, application support and training/education to new and existing sequencing and pathology customers. The primary role of this position is to collaborate with sales, support teams, and serve as the scientific/technical expert to help drive sales and provide support for customers. While some work may be performed remotely, this position requires approximately 50\-60% travel (including overnight travel) to customer sites across India.
  
  

Key Roles\& Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide scientific support and workflow optimization across pre\- and post\-sales, using broad operational knowledge of diverse brand sequencers to benchmark performance, optimize run parameters, and troubleshoot platform\-specific chemistry or hardware challenges
* Take ownership and drive improvement of technical support for pre\- and post\-sales including troubleshooting and simple data analysis on Roche products for affiliates and customers.
* Gather and deliver strategic and competitive feedback, communicating use cases to Global and Regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate and/or perform application training and demonstrations.
* Report on activities in the field on a regular basis to upper management


Who You Are
  
  

* Experience in sequencing laboratory discipline is required including sample preparation, workflow and target capture.
* Experience in teamwork and project management in matrix organization.
* A great team player with willingness for travel up to 60% of the time.
* Familiarity with the technological trends and their relevance to the healthcare industry


**Qualification and Experience:**  

* Ph.D. or equivalent experience preferred; bachelor’s or master’s Degree with at least 5 years lab experience in molecular biology, biotechnology or appropriate biological or biomedical science field.
* At least 5 years of practical application experience in providing applications trainings and support in experimental design, troubleshooting, NGS wet lab experience (library prep, PCR and target enrichment) and troubleshooting a wide variety of commercial sequencing instruments (e.g., Roche, Illumina, Thermo Fisher/Ion Torrent, PacBio, MGI).
* Familiar with bioinformatics software, methodologies and NGS application in oncology.
* Solid commercial acumen which can be demonstrated by previous success in bringing the benefits of sales, marketing or operational experience to solve business issues or capitalize on market opportunities.
* Clear vision of and commitment to providing outstanding customer service.
* Excellent organization, analytical and systematic troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team towards corporate goals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Outstanding presentation and training skills.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

description:

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 CrowdStrike is in search of a Systems Engineer III to join our growing Production Services team. The candidate will play an important role in the architecture and management of our production systems environments.

title: Systems Engineer, Staff - SoC Interconnect / NoC Systems Architecture
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
**General Summary:**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Systems Engineer** to drive the architecture and development of next generation System\-on\-Chip (SoC) interconnect solutions powering data center, automotive, smartphone, notebook, tablet, XR, smart glasses, and emerging compute platforms.


The candidate will be a key member of the **NoC Systems Architecture Team** , responsible for defining system requirements, developing Network\-on\-Chip (NoC) architecture specifications, and collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines to deliver scalable, high\-performance, and power\-efficient SoC solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Interconnect Architecture and System Definition**

* Contribute to the definition and evolution of SoC interconnect and Network\-on\-Chip (NoC) architectures.
* Gather and analyze system requirements, understand product use cases, and translate them into interconnect architecture and functional specifications.
* Define performance, scalability, quality\-of\-service (QoS), coherency, and latency requirements for interconnect subsystems.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable NoC topologies, routing algorithms, arbitration mechanisms, and traffic management schemes.

**System Modeling and Analysis**

* Develop and utilize behavioral or analytical models to study NoC performance and design trade\-offs.
* Analyze system traffic patterns and data flows to optimize interconnect bandwidth, latency, and power efficiency.
* Collaborate with performance teams to validate architectural decisions through modeling and simulation.

**SoC Architecture Collaboration**

* Work closely with CPU, GPU, AI/ML, Multimedia, Memory, Security, Power, and other subsystem teams to define interconnect requirements.
* Develop a strong understanding of:



	+ SoC boot flows
	+ Security architecture
	+ Clock and reset architecture
	+ Power management architecture
	+ System\-level data flows and performance requirements

**Cross\-Functional Engagement**

* Partner with architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, floorplanning, power, and silicon validation teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with global engineering teams across multiple sites to ensure alignment on interconnect architecture and implementation.
* Support post\-silicon validation efforts by correlating pre\-silicon assumptions with measured silicon behavior.

**Technology Leadership and Innovation**

* Stay current with evolving industry standards, including:



	+ ARM AMBA specifications
	+ CHI , AXI, AHB, ACE/ACE\-Lite protocols
	+ PCI Express (PCIe)
	+ CXL
	+ Ethernet
	+ UALink
	+ Coherency and virtualization technologies
	+ Low\-power design methodologies
* Drive continuous improvements in interconnect architecture, design methodologies, performance optimization, and power efficiency.
* Propose innovative architectural solutions for future generation NoC and interconnect technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **7 to 11 years** of experience in SoC architecture, SoC design, NoC architecture, or related system engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of on\-chip interconnect concepts and industry\-standard protocols, including:



	+ ARM CHI
	+ AXI/AHB
	+ ACE/ACE\-Lite
	+ NoC architectures and coherency concepts
* Good understanding of digital design fundamentals and RTL implementation concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with Verilog/SystemVerilog based RTL development and SoC design methodologies.
* Understanding of multi\-core ARMv8/ARMv9 architectures, cache coherency, memory hierarchy, and virtualization concepts.
* Familiarity with performance analysis, system modeling, and architectural trade\-off studies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience with large\-scale SoC architecture for data center, AI/ML, mobile, automotive, or high\-performance compute applications.
* Knowledge of PCIe, CXL, memory subsystems, coherency fabrics, and virtualization technologies.
* Experience working with performance modeling, silicon validation, or system\-level architecture analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross\-functional teams and drive technical discussions across organizational boundaries.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
